email.title: Email address
email.description: A single email address to look up. For a quick one-off. To process many at once, use the Emails list below instead.

emails.title: Emails (bulk)
emails.description: A list of email addresses. Each one becomes one result row with its best-match LinkedIn profile and a confidence score. Role mailboxes like info@ or support@ are skipped automatically. The two prefilled addresses are a live demo: one resolves with high confidence, one as a possible match. Replace them with your own.

aiMode.title: AI assistance
aiMode.description: How much the AI is used. No AI: fastest and free, only the clear matches resolve, anything uncertain is left unscored. Balanced (recommended): the AI steps in only on the uncertain matches. Full AI: the AI works on every email, highest match rate but highest cost and slowest.
enumTitles: Full AI  -  AI on everything, highest match rate

minConfidencePct.title: Minimum confidence to scrape (%)
minConfidencePct.description: Only profiles the tool is at least this confident about are accepted (and scraped, if scraping is on). Lower means more coverage but more wrong matches. 80 is a safe default.

deepEnrich.title: Check public profiles (recommended)
deepEnrich.description: Looks the address up across public developer and social profiles (GitHub, Gravatar, PGP keyservers, handle probes on 8 platforms) to recover the person's name and a handle that is consistent across sites. That handle is what resolves a LinkedIn URL when no search key is given. Adds about 5 to 10 seconds per email. Turn it off only for speed when you supply a Brave Search key.

scrapeProfiles.title: Scrape the matched profile
scrapeProfiles.description: After a confident match, also fetch the full LinkedIn profile details. Needs a Bright Data key below. Off by default, so the actor just returns the profile URL and confidence (no scraping, no extra cost).

runMode.title: Run mode
runMode.description: Incremental uses only free resolvers (default, runs forever at near-zero cost). Backfill also allows the paid hosted email-to-LinkedIn vendor for a one-time history sweep (needs a Findymail key).
enumTitles: Backfill  -  also allow paid hosted lookup

groqApiKey.title: Groq API key
groqApiKey.description: Your Groq key (starts with gsk_), free tier is generous. Powers the AI steps. Only needed if AI assistance is Balanced or Full. Get one at console.groq.com/keys.
groqApiKey.sectionDescription: All optional. Add only the keys for the features you want. Nothing here is stored beyond the run.

braveApiKey.title: Brave Search API key
braveApiKey.description: Your Brave Search key. Powers the web search that finds candidate LinkedIn profiles. Without a search key the actor still resolves what it can from the email's public footprint alone.

googleCseKey.title: Google Custom Search key
googleCseKey.description: Alternative to Brave for the search step. Only works with a legacy Custom Search key (Google closed new sign-ups). Provide together with the CX id below.

googleCseCx.title: Google Custom Search CX id
googleCseCx.description: The search engine id that pairs with the Google Custom Search key above.

brightdataApiKey.title: Bright Data API key
brightdataApiKey.description: Enables real LinkedIn profile scraping when 'Scrape the matched profile' is on. Without it, the actor resolves the URL but does not scrape.

findymailApiKey.title: Findymail API key
findymailApiKey.description: Optional paid email-to-LinkedIn fallback, used only in Backfill run mode for emails the free resolvers miss.
